items.summary:

items.title: Why AI is Intelligent: Scientific Concept of a Mathematical Manifold
items.summary:
This my first AI generated video with the new experimental (beta) features of Google's Gemini models. And it focusses on the most important part of AI, the data manifold.

I am on a journey to learn how to utilize AI for educational goals, and I have to accelerate my learning quite a lot. So I utilize the latest tech in AI for this purpose: to learn the latest  in Computer Science and Mathematics (daily new pre-prints), the latest AI tools and how to communicate complex topics to my audience. I am the main bottleneck and my slow speed of learning. 

This content was generate by Gemini (Google) based on my papers, my scripts and the ArXiv papers I had selected and stored on my Google drive directory - especially configured for this video. The design and the presented text was generated by Gemini, although I modified some presentation details and corrected some mistakes.

So welcome to my journey. 

How can we create synthetic videos from a scientific presentation, where the presentation itself was generated after an intense discussion with my AI? 

In the upcoming two videos, on Saturday and Sunday, I will show you step by step how I created this video and we will compare GPT-5.6 Sol (high) to an old Gemini 3.1 PRO model for video generation for educational, explanatory videos on Science and Technology. 

#airesearch 
#aiexplained 
#gemini 
#geminiai #mathematics #aivideo #educationalvideo

items.title: An AI Assistant in Every Notebook, Sidebars, Visual Themes and More Notebook Technologies
items.summary:
In Version 15, we're launching a new level of AI integration: our built-in AI Assistant. It's immediately available in all Wolfram Notebooks with no configuration needed. But there's more to say about new notebook features! Sidebars are being introduced in desktop notebooks, and visual themes offer fresh options to make notebooks look different. And for each theme, there's both a light mode and dark mode version. Join Wolfram user interface developers at this webinar to learn more about all the new Version 15 functionality in Wolfram Notebooks and see demonstrations of the AI Assistant at work as well as the external coding environment with MCP connectors.

items.title: AMA with Luis Serrano
items.summary:
Luis Serrano is an AI scientist and educator. Previously, he was a Machine Learning Engineer at Google and Lead Artificial Intelligence Educator at Apple.

In this session, we’ll ask these questions:
- Why does ML feel so intimidating to beginners?
- Who is Grokking Algorithms book really for?
- What is new in the latest edition of the book?
- Why do ML fundamentals still matter in the age of LLMs?
- Where should someone start with machine learning today?
- How can learners move beyond just copying tutorials?
- Why is visual intuition so important in ML?
- How do you explain overfitting in simple terms?
- How should beginners choose the right ML algorithm?
- Why is accuracy sometimes a bad metric?
- How much math do people really need for ML?
- How does the book make ML practical with Python?
- Why do neural networks feel like magic?
- What’s the simplest way to understand neural networks?
- What should readers be able to do after finishing the book?

This is a live, interactive session, bring your questions for Luis.
 
We will also giveaway Ebooks to 2 lucky winners during the session. Comment #AI to enter the raffle!

AMD's AI deals with Microsoft, Meta, Oracle, OpenAI and Anthropic are being driven by customer confidence in its roadmap, says AMD SVP Ravi Kuppuswamy.

Speaking to Analytics India Magazine at Advancing AI 2026, Kuppuswamy said customers are increasingly looking at AMD's AI portfolio as a complete rack-level solution with Helios, alongside its CPU, GPU and networking roadmap. He said the combined platform delivers strong performance, confidential computing capabilities and an improved user experience.

"The user experience has been tremendously good, which is why you are seeing the adoption exploding across all the deals that you mentioned earlier."
